rules.diagnostics: A matching URI and explicitly present integer version establish only that document version. Versionless observations never establish exact-version admission. Reopened documents need a distinct incarnation or an unavailable attribution result.
rules.freshness: A cross-document mutation needs a distinguishing semantic witness for all relevant changed inputs, not merely the queried document version.
rules.first: First target operation after fully logged preparation. No target warmup may precede it.
rules.timing: Client monotonic request submission through full response receipt; transition submission through correct result. Preserve both. Never add overlapping native spans as elapsed time.
rules.missing: An unavailable number is null with a reason. It is never zero.
rules.gate: Write raw artifacts before failing on incorrect/stale/error/timeout/not-run mandatory cases. Unsupported requires predeclared capability evidence. Warmup correctness is mandatory.
rules.statistics: Independent restored runs are the outer unit. Within-process requests remain nested. Ten independent blocks is the minimum for a public comparative performance claim, not a precision guarantee.
